**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed)

Section 24 satisfies the ASSIGN preferred position on every material term:

- **24.1** — Customer may assign to an Affiliate or M&A successor without Vendor consent (prompt notice + assumption of obligations only).
- **24.2** — Vendor assignment, delegation of material performance, and transfer by change of control all require our prior written consent (not unreasonably withheld), with a never-to-a-competitor bar.
- **24.3** — Mutual reasonable-consent standard for other assignments.
- **24.4** — Our change of control gives Vendor no right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees or reduce service, plus a cooperation obligation for a permitted successor.
- **13.3** — Licence rights travel with a permitted assignment.

No walk-away trigger exists: there is no blanket prohibition on our assignment and no Vendor exit or re-pricing right on our change of control. The only other assignment-adjacent provision, 9.2 (insolvency/general assignment for creditors), is mutual and expressly excludes a lawful reorganization that does not impair performance, so it does not create a back-door change-of-control termination right against us.
